en: “...Yeah.”
“Yeah, it's interesting.”
Shizuku and I are back at the backyard, sitting in the corridor.
I'm reading the novel Shizuku wrote while enjoying this little afternoon break.
“Whew... Wonderful.”
“I've been writing a lot recently. I'm worried it might not be so good.”
“But there's one spot that after I edited it, I was really happy with...”
“Is it this bit?”
“You could tell?”
“Yeah, it feels like this bit is being forced a little to move the story along.”
“Like that...”
“But I still have lots of ideas of what I want to do once you've read it!”
“What is it? Did you find something bad?”
“I just feel like you're smiling a lot lately, Shizuku.”
“—Heh?”
“Hehe. Are you saying that Shizuku's smile is the cutest?”
“I was wondering how Shizuku got so close to you... Now I know.”
“Erm... It was kinda me getting close to her.”
“Whatever, I'm a fan too.”
“Kasumi just made these cookies. She said they'd beat {Me}'s cookies.”
“You've been teaching me for so long now. It wouldn't be good if we had nothing to show for it.”
“No worries. At least this time they're not burnt. That's a big improvement.”
“Hmph... Do you have to keep bringing that up!”
“Haven't you guys read Shizuku's novel?”
“Of course not.”
“Why... Why would I let them read it?!”
“I already know that the whole thing is filled with smut.”
“Yeah, dad was so mad.”
“But you still let {Me} read it and not us...”
“I can't help but feel a little sad—”
“That... Um...”
“I kinda read it by accident.”
“If I read it by accident, I'd probably end up unconscious.”
“Besides, let me tell you, when she first came here, her face was sour.”
“You were the same, Ayano! You were forever complaining about dad!”
“Yeah, I mean, dad is way too strict.”
“Besides, he was extra hard on you.”
“Whatever, I'm gonna show him that he was wrong.”
“Heyyy, the look on your face makes me think you might be right.”
“You have the confidence of a girl in her first ever relationship.”
“While we're on the subject, Shizuku, I'd like to say something to you.”
“Ayano, she knows about what happened to your computer. She and dad argued about it for a long time.”
“...Argued?”
“Ah—W-Wait, I thought we weren't going to talk about that—”
“It's just a little something, there's no need to be like that—”
“Ayano...?”
“Yeah, I think you're crossing a line here...”
“Happy now—?”
“It's not too late to remember that you still love your sister.”
“Hey, don't be like that.”
“Then you should let me read your novel—?!”
“No way.”
“Oh my... You refused right off the bat.”
“But you know... If the day comes when I'm ready...”
“You guys will be the first to read it...”
“Well then, I'm looking forward to that day.”
“It's all on you now, {Me}!”
“Shizuku really is amazing. I don't think you'll be waiting long!”
“...Yeah.”
“If we get found out this time...”
“Ah, yeah... it'll be a total shit show.”
“He's dad after all...”
All three of them suddenly turn to look at me.
“Eh?”
“What were you playing at, making all three of us fall in love with you ♡”
Kasumi&Ayano&Shizuku
